purpose: Root-cause fix for the second flake escalated by this session: the QC fixture port-binding test.

contentGuard.blobEquality: trivially satisfied - reviewed commit == PR head; no update-branch was performed
contentGuard.frozenCampContractUntouched: confirmed - the diff touches only the two files above

updateBranch.reason: NOT NEEDED - head 3bfc4387e was already UP-TO-DATE with origin/main (91b66b04c). The PR reported mergeStateStatus BLOCKED, which reflected checks still running, not an out-of-date branch.

rootCauseFix.why: The old fixture port range sits INSIDE the Linux default ephemeral/local port range (32768-60999), so a concurrently-running process could have the supposedly reserved fixture port auto-assigned out from under the fixture bind. The new range sits below the ephemeral range. This is a genuine root cause, consistent with the intermittent, diff-uncorrelated failures this session observed.
failuresThisFixExplains: #1720 (2026-09-15, run 34982536757): Unit Tests (6/6) failed `GM and two-player campaign QC runner > refuses and preserves a ready foreign server on the fixture port` on a PR whose diff was three React share-panel files
#1741 (2026-09-15, run 35004702076): the identical test and assertion failed on a PR whose diff was two inserted awaits in a Playwright spec
rootCauseFix.supersedesReruns: Both earlier occurrences were cleared with a single targeted rerun after establishing diff non-causation. This PR removes the underlying cause rather than masking it.

checksAtTerminal.stopConditionNote: The coordinator instructed: if the port-binding test itself fails on this PR's own run, stop and report rather than rerun. It did NOT fail - Unit Tests (6/6) went green at 18:38:19 and stayed green - so the stop condition was never triggered and NO rerun was performed on this PR.

mergedContentVerification: The merge commit changes exactly the 2 guarded files, both blob-identical to the gated head.

flakeLedgerAfterThisMerge.qcFixturePortFlake: fixed by this PR (port range moved below the ephemeral range)
flakeLedgerAfterThisMerge.recommendation: Watch the next several PRs to confirm both stay quiet; neither should now require a rerun.
